newsitem.title: HONG KONG: YGM's Hang Ten expanding retail presence.
newsitem.headline: YGM's Hang Ten expanding retail presence.

text.p: YGM Trading Ltd's 63.9 percent owned ILC International Corp has expanded its chain of apparel retail stores in Southeast Asia which operate under the trademark "Hang Ten", ILC said in a statement on Wednesday.
ILC said it had opened two shops in Hong Kong -- in Kowloon and in Causeway Bay -- as part of its expansion plan, and it was looking at other possible locations in the territory.

ILC, which has opened four Hang Ten outlets in Manila in October, will open six franchised outlets in Manila by the end of 1996 with some 40 to 50 stores planned for the country over the next three to four years.
The company said it was in discussions to establish joint ventures in Thailand, Indonesia, China, Malaysia, India and the Middle East.
ILC controls a network of retails stores operating in Taiwan, Singapore, Myanmar, the Philippines, Macau and Hong Kong.
